title: Trump Effort to Prove Rampant Noncitizen Voting Leads to Few Charges So Far
summary: Just 236 people have been charged with voting-fraud-related offenses by the Trump administration, despite its unsubstantiated claims that fraud is widespread.
body_markdown: Just 236 people have been charged with voting-fraud-related offenses by the Trump administration, despite its unsubstantiated claims that fraud is widespread.
